summary: Fixed the eight bugs the tests expose (rate file ranges, rounding rule, per-entry month totals, negative amount formatting, reversal booking, backward rate lookup, tax effective dates, header precedence) and the rule violations the audit reports: valuation quarters in tax returns, rounded book values and matrix cells, signed HTML total cells, core rounding for recurring groups, chart bars and cross rates, the jurisdiction line in written statements and the fiscal year of the start month.
